description: Evolution des émissions directes de méthane depuis 2016 générées par l’activité de NaTran et de Teréga is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de donnée fournit l'évolution des émissions directes de méthane depuis 2016 généré par l'activité de NaTran et de Teréga. Les données sont issues des rapports intégrés respectifs de chaque transporteur. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are RSE. The portal shows 2021-03-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
